dataset.dataset_name: CalCOFI Supplemental Data from Monterey Bay (1955-1963) - Stanford Hopkins Marine Station

category.name: Physical Oceanography
category.description: Temperature, salinity, density, oxygen, pressure and dynamic height from bottles and CTD casts

dataset.description_md: CalCOFI Supplemental Data from Monterey Bay contains additional hydrographic, meteorological, and biological observations collected by the Hopkins Marine Station of Stanford University as part of the California Cooperative Oceanic Fisheries Investigations (CalCOFI) program, including temperature, salinity, dissolved oxygen, phosphate, silicate, meteorological conditions, and fish and marine mammal counts. The dataset covers Monterey Bay, California, as part of Hopkins Marine Station's weekly CalCOFI sampling program that ran from March 1951 through June 1974. The underlying records exist primarily as digitized images and PDF scans of the original field notebooks and reports, housed in the Stanford Digital Repository, with extraction into a structured, actionable dataset still in progress as of the most recent public update. This dataset supports historical research on oceanographic and ecological conditions in Monterey Bay and is intended for researchers studying long-term environmental change in the California Current.
